title: The Hunter's Secret
summary: With Director Kang defeated, Captain Baek hands over the Master Cryptographic Key to Section 9. Ha-Jun discovers Kang Tae-Jun's encrypted audio diary, revealing his brother's sacred mission.

panels.shot: rain falling on silent mapo bridge wide shot
panels.action: The heavy downpour begins to slow as grey dawn mist rises from the Han River; emergency lights hum.

panels.shot: fifty bureau hunters kneeling or lowering weapons
panels.action: The fifty elite hunters stand in reverent silence, looking at Ha-Jun and Captain Baek with newfound awe.

panels.shot: school bus doors opening with clicks
panels.action: The pneumatic doors of the trapped school buses hiss open; terrified teachers and children step out safely.

panels.shot: a small child waving tearfully at ha-jun
panels.action: A 7yo girl in a yellow raincoat clutches her teddy bear and waves with a relieved smile: 'Thank you, Mister!'

panels.shot: ha-jun faint warm smile through exhaustion
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fierce battle expression softens; he gives a subtle, warm nod to the child.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Inhi ke liye... Main is power ko use karunga.

panels.shot: captain baek sheathing the eclipse greatsword
panels.action: Captain Baek locks his heavy broadsword into the magnetic back scabbard with a solid metallic clank.

panels.shot: baek removing his armored tactical helmet
panels.action: Baek removes his helmet, revealing a scarred, rugged 42yo face with honest, weathered brown eyes.

panels.shot: baek offering right hand to ha-jun
panels.action: Captain Baek extends his heavy, calloused hand directly to 17-year-old Ha-Jun.

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Maine tumhare baare mein galat faisla kiya tha, Ha-Jun. Mujhe maaf kar do.

panels.shot: ha-jun shaking baek hand firmly
panels.action: Ha-Jun grips Baek's hand firmly with his bare right hand; no mana, just mutual human respect.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Aap dushman nahi the, Captain. Aap bas wahi kar rahe the jo aapko sahi laga.

panels.shot: baek pulling titanium access card from breastplate
panels.action: Baek retrieves a black obsidian-titanium smart card engraved with 'CLEARANCE LEVEL 10: SECTION 9'.

panels.shot: baek handing card to ha-jun
panels.action: Baek presses the master card into Ha-Jun's palm: 'Yeh Section 9 Underground Cryo-Facility ki key hai.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Gangnam Station ke 300 meter niche... Tumhare bhai ko wahan stasis mein rakha gaya hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring at the card with racing heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers trace the cold titanium edges; his brother is finally within reach.

panels.shot: baek unlocking encrypted audio log on card
panels.action: Baek taps a micro-speaker on the card: 'Yeh Kang Tae-Jun ka last recorded message hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun voice crackling through speaker
panels.action: A warm, mature, deeply loving voice echoes from the speaker: 'Ha-Jun... Agar tum yeh sun rahe ho...'

dialogue.text: "Ha-Jun... Agar tum yeh sun rahe ho, toh iska matlab tumhare andar Sovereign jaag chuka hai."

panels.shot: ha-jun tears spilling onto the card
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes fill with tears as his elder brother's voice wraps around his soul like a warm embrace.

panels.shot: tae-jun audio explaining the seven year sacrifice
panels.action: Tae-Jun's voice continues: 'Maine Director Kang ko distract kiya taaki tum school complete kar sako.'

dialogue.text: "Main janta tha ki mere DNA mein poori authority nahi thi... Lekin tumhare paas True Sovereign ka blood hai."

panels.shot: tae-jun warning of the abyssal gate
panels.action: Tae-Jun's voice turns solemn: 'Lekin Kang toh bas ek mohtaaz tha... Asli khatra Abyss ke teen Demon Kings hain.'

dialogue.text: "Section 9 ke theek niche Gate open hone wala hai. Relics ko dhoondho, mere bhai."

panels.shot: audio log ending with tender words
panels.action: Tae-Jun whispers: 'Mujhe tumpar garv hai, Ha-Jun. Stay strong. I love you.'

dialogue.text: "Mujhe tumpar garv hai... Hamesha tha, aur hamesha rahega."

panels.shot: ha-jun pressing the card against his heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses the card against his Sovereign Crest, drawing deep strength into his soul.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main aa raha hoon, Bhai. Aur koi taaqat mujhe rok nahi sakti.

panels.shot: kuro looking up with fierce battle fire
panels.action: Kuro spreads his dark wings: 'Tae-Jun ne ground prepare kiya... Ab harvest hum karenge!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Section 9 mein humara next Rare Relic bhi sealed hai: The Fang of Abyss!

panels.shot: min-jae driving up with tactical command van
panels.action: Min-Jae pulls the van alongside Ha-Jun and Baek, sliding the door open.

dialogue.speaker: min-jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun! Gangnam Station ke subterranean sensors par massive earthquake detect hua hai!

panels.shot: ground beneath mapo bridge trembling violently
panels.action: A deep, sickening seismic rumble reverberates through the concrete bridge piers; Han River waters churn.

panels.shot: distant violet pillar of energy erupting over gangnam
panels.action: Five miles away over Gangnam, a colossal 500-foot column of pure dark-violet abyssal energy pierces the clouds.

panels.shot: sky over seoul turning midnight purple at dawn
panels.action: The dawn sunlight is swallowed by creeping dark purple celestial fog; demonic runes swirl in the clouds.

panels.shot: captain baek staring at the horizon in dread
panels.action: Baek grips his greatsword: 'Yeh koi earthquake nahi hai... The Abyssal Gate has broken through.'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Director Kang ke marne se unka seal collapse ho gaya! The Demon Realm is invading!

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping into the driver passenger seat
panels.action: Ha-Jun jumps into the van, eyes blazing like twin supernovas.

panels.shot: captain baek jumping into his armored command humvee
panels.action: Baek radios all fifty hunters: 'All Bureau units, form escort formation around that civilian van!'

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: Hunters! We fight with the Demon Sovereign today! Protect the City!!

panels.shot: convoy of police, hunters, and van speeding down highway
panels.action: A breathtaking united convoy of Bureau armored vehicles escorting Ha-Jun's van toward Gangnam.

panels.shot: kuro flying at the head of the armada
panels.action: Kuro leads the charge through the violet rain, his eyes blazing with primordial glory.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring through windshield at the violet rift
panels.action: Ha-Jun's reflection in the glass: bone gauntlet raised, blood blades ready, heart united with his brother.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Bhai, main aa gaya hoon... Ab hum mil kar is Abyss ko band karenge.
